subject: Life Skills
title: Feet Never Lie
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Feet Never Lie.

hook.text: FBI agent Joe Navarro says the most honest body part is not the face. It is the feet.

buildup.text: People control their face and hands consciously. Feet are far from the brain and rarely managed or monitored.

discovery.text: If someone's feet point toward the door while talking to you, they want to leave.

twist.text: Happy feet — bouncing or tapping — signal excitement. Suddenly frozen feet after a question signals stress or deception.

climax.text: Next time you talk to someone, glance down once. Feet aimed at you means engagement.

punchline.text: The face performs. The feet confess.

quiz.question: Why are feet considered the most honest body part?
options: Feet are the strongest muscles in the body
People rarely think to control their foot position
Feet always point in the direction you want to go
